protocol.question: Peak additional physical unified-memory pressure of previous and new main defaults, without RSS double counting.
protocol.order: previous,new for replicate 1; new,previous for replicate 2, sequential GPU jobs
protocol.workload: Base/pLDDT repeat the same 100 public targets ten times; language uses five distinct public examples. No sequence or embedding cache.
protocol.settings: Installed defaults; CUDA; seed 42; PDB output; optional chemistry off. Previous auto uses eight workers for the 1000-input jobs; new auto uses one batched strict-FP32 saved model. Previous TF32 policy retained. No command changes precision, worker count or batch size.
protocol.timing: Host wall time around fresh docker run, including startup, imports, loading, inference, PDB writes and exit. Build/export/ProtT5 download excluded.
protocol.memory: Do not add PSS, CUDA, RSS or cgroup counters. Global measurement can include unrelated host activity; idle windows and full traces retained.
protocol.summary: Median complete wall times; min/max ranges for two technical replicates; higher observed sampled memory peak across replicates. No statistical significance or biological accuracy claim.
protocol.primary_metric: Median MemAvailable over 5s before docker run minus minimum MemAvailable sampled every 20ms during the complete fresh container lifetime. Report as additional unavailable system RAM at peak, not an exact process allocation. Linux estimator includes shared CPU/GPU pressure once.
protocol.secondary_metrics: MemFree/cache/slab/swap counters at the same timestamps; summed process-tree PSS and private pages every 200ms inside the container; complete wall time for context only.
protocol.baseline: 5 seconds immediately before each run and 8 seconds after exit; record median, range and post-minus-pre drift. No cache dropping, no swap changes. Flag >0.25 GiB idle drift; do not silently discard observations.
protocol.calibration: 4 GiB touched CPU allocation: 4.05 GiB decrease in MemAvailable; adding 4 GiB CUDA: combined 8.17 GiB decrease. After release: residual 0.08 GiB, within idle tolerance. Full calibration retained.

timing_source: abodybuilder3_main_comparison_261026.json; earlier separate matched timing study; not re-timed by this memory study.
limitations: MemAvailable is an OS estimate of RAM usable without swapping, not exact process ownership.
Post-job available memory differed from pre-job by up to 0.939 GiB; all flagged runs retained.
Sensitivity endpoints use either pre-idle or post-idle median and both repetitions; they are not confidence intervals.
No swap change observed. GPU and CPU pressure are measured together; do not add CUDA or PSS.
